<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/plugins/frame-tokens"}
  context={"endpoint"}

The same as /plugins/\{id\}/frame-token for a list of plugins, so a page load asks once instead of once per plugin. Plugins that are not running with framed views are left out of the answer.
